outcomeNote: mishna statement with R' Yosei's addition

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ לְשֵׁם שִׁשָּׁה דְּבָרִים הַזֶּבַח נִזְבָּח: לְשֵׁם זֶבַח, לְשֵׁם זוֹבֵחַ, לְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁם, לְשֵׁם אִשִּׁים, לְשֵׁם רֵיחַ, לְשֵׁם נִיחוֹחַ. וְהַחַטָּאת וְהָאָשָׁם – לְשֵׁם חֵטְא.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The slaughtered offering is slaughtered for the sake of six matters,» and one must have all of these matters in mind: «For the sake of» the particular type of «offering» being sacrificed; «for the sake of the one who sacrifices» the offering; «for the sake of God; for the sake of» consumption by the «fires» of the altar; «for the sake of» the «aroma; for the sake of» the «pleasing» of God, i.e., in fulfillment of God’s will; «and,» in the cases of «a sin offering and a guilt offering, for the sake of» atonement for the «sin.»

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי: אַף מִי שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּלִבּוֹ לְשֵׁם אֶחָד מִכׇּל אֵלּוּ – כָּשֵׁר; שֶׁהוּא תְּנַאי בֵּית דִּין, שֶׁאֵין הַמַּחְשָׁבָה הוֹלֶכֶת אֶלָּא אַחַר הָעוֹבֵד.
segments.en: «Rabbi Yosei says: Even» in the case of «one who did not have in mind» to slaughter the offering «for the sake of any one of these,» the offering is «valid, as it is a stipulation of the court» that he should not state any intent ab initio. This is necessary «because the intent follows only the one performing the» sacrificial «rite,» and therefore if the one who slaughters the animal is not careful and states the wrong intent, the offering would be disqualified through his improper intent.
